scene.name: workbench
scene.coordinates: world XYZ in meters; z=0 is the support surface
scene.perception: RGB only from the calibrated and wrist cameras; no depth. 3D comes from the plane assumption: intersect a pixel ray with a stated horizontal plane, or give propose an object_height to estimate where an upright object of that size stands on the table. Object locations must still be observed, not assumed
scene.motion: IK with joint limits; no general collision-free path planner

cameras.note: calibrated placement reproduces the measured real RGB camera (undistorted intrinsics and pose relative to the table); simulated images still differ in lighting, texture and the robot model

robot_base_in_world.note: the simulation stands the base upright at the world origin; the calibrated base frame sits this far above and tilted from the table, largely absorbing joint-zero/extrinsic compensation, so the robot as seen by the simulated camera differs from the real image by about this much

scene.coordinates: world XYZ in meters; z=0 is the support surface
scene.perception: RGB only from the calibrated and wrist cameras; no depth. 3D comes from the plane assumption: intersect a pixel ray with a stated horizontal plane, or give propose an object_height to estimate where an upright object of that size stands on the table. Object locations must still be observed, not assumed
scene.motion: IK with joint limits; no general collision-free path planner

cameras.note: calibrated placement reproduces the measured real RGB camera (undistorted intrinsics and pose relative to the table); simulated images still differ in lighting, texture and the robot model

robot_base_in_world.note: the simulation stands the base upright at the world origin; the calibrated base frame sits this far above and tilted from the table, largely absorbing joint-zero/extrinsic compensation, so the robot as seen by the simulated camera differs from the real image by about this much

command.evidence: 全程仅用 joints(delta_deg/target_deg) + gripper，未用 move/look_at。绿色方块 5 次合爪尝试均未能抓起：每次视觉(wrist 相机)对齐看似良好(方块位于双爪之间)，合爪后上抬，calibrated 画面显示方块仍留在桌面原地、机械臂已抬空，抓取失败。过程中每次未遂的合爪/触碰都把方块推移了几毫米到几厘米，方块最终从(0.188,-0.171)累计推移到(0.129,-0.098)附近。诊断出两个非IK方式特有的实际困难：(1) 关节高度折叠(elbow_flex 约>70°同时 wrist_flex 也大)时手爪会与前臂自身发生碰撞形成硬限位，继续加大该关节目标角度完全不产生运动（已用 wait 和更大 target_deg 验证过并非结算延迟，是真实的自碰撞/接触阻挡）；(2) 该姿态下 elbow_flex 存在明显重力下垂稳态误差（命中 target_deg 75 时实际稳定在约53°，约22°落差），单纯冲大目标角度不能补偿，需要先卸载再重试。这些是这次不使用IK、纯关节点动+视觉/本体反馈方式暴露出的真实限制，已如实记录，未继续无限重试。
